title: 美债收益率6%：日本持有者占大头，他们会买还是卖？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: How much of our long-end is on-guy Japan?
segments.zh: 我们的长期国债有多少是日本持有的？

segments.en: Let's just say a important share in terms of APAC of international investors.
segments.zh: 可以说，在亚太地区的国际市场参与者中，日本占了重要份额。

segments.en: We've just repaid the custodians. APAC are good.
segments.zh: 我们刚刚偿还了托管人，亚太地区表现良好。

segments.en: One-eighth to one-seventh, out of that.
segments.zh: 其中大约八分之一到七分之一。

segments.en: I think Japan is dominant in terms of all of it.
segments.zh: 我认为日本在其中占据主导地位。

segments.en: But you will see their data or not see their data in terms of custodian centres elsewhere in Europe as well.
segments.zh: 但你在欧洲其他托管中心可能看到或看不到他们的数据。

segments.en: And you see how numbers out of Belgium and UK a lot of that is going to keep the Japanese and Asian.
segments.zh: 你会看到比利时和英国的数据，其中很多是日本和亚洲的。

segments.en: What if we slip price down yield up to a 6% 30-year bond?
segments.zh: 如果价格下跌，收益率升至6%的30年期国债会怎样？

segments.en: Well, you tell me where the break even is going to be and then we can tell you who's going to be buying and who's not going to be selling.
segments.zh: 你告诉我盈亏平衡点在哪里，我们就能告诉你谁会买，谁不会卖。

segments.en: If we get to, okay, five, six, pick a number.
segments.zh: 如果我们达到，比如5%、6%，随便选个数。

segments.en: If the break even still stays to two and a half, happy days for domestic pension investors.
segments.zh: 如果盈亏平衡点仍保持在2.5%，国内养老金市场参与者将迎来好日子。

segments.en: It's not just a US story. You're seeing that in Europe. You're seeing that in the UK in particular.
segments.zh: 这不仅仅是美国的故事，在欧洲、特别是在英国也能看到类似情况。

segments.en: Let's get the real yield right because the higher that is, the better it is.
segments.zh: 让我们关注实际收益率，因为它越高越好。
